name: agentic-ds-kit

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List every UI component in this install, blocks included. Each entry has the code name, the catalog group as category, kind (component, or block for a larger composition such as AgentOverview), and a one-line purpose from its contract. Use get_component for props and rules.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get one component by code name or contract id (Button or button). Returns props, enum variants, must and doNot rules, the tokens the contract lists, an import line, and a usage example from the contract snippet.

name.description: Component code name or contract id, such as Button or button.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Find components whose name, purpose, or contract keywords match. Keywords are the contract useWhen, doNotUseWhen, and doNot lines. Every word must match. Case-insensitive.

query.description: Words to match, such as "date" or "kpi".

tools.name: get_tokens
tools.description: Semantic tokens from this install, with the CSS variable name, the value, and the usage note from tokens/usage.json. Groups: color (light value plus dark), type, space, radius, grid. Omit group for all five. Primitive --color-* ramps are not included.

group.description: color, type, space, radius, or grid. Omit for all five.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List copy-in screen patterns. Each entry has an id, a one-line description, and the npx agentic-ds-kit add command that copies it into an app.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Get one pattern by id (dashboard or app-shell). Returns the description, the npx agentic-ds-kit add command, and the contract must and defaults.

id.description: Pattern id, such as dashboard or app-shell.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: Return this install's AGENTS.md, including the page-layout rule for layout classes and --grid-* tokens. This is the rule text agents should follow.

tools.name: questions
tools.description: Build the same closed option list as `npx agentic-ds-kit questions` from this install's contracts. Pass no arguments for the full list. Options match the CLI: only, group (component or pattern), overlay (the JSON object, not a file path), none, useWhen, notWhen, askStyle (part or strict), enums (own, all, or none).

overlay.description: Overlay object with only, composites, options, and/or drop. Same shape as the questions --overlay file.

instructions: Read-only catalog of the agentic-ds-kit install this process was started from. Use these tools for components, tokens, patterns, kit rules, and the questions option list. Answers come from that install's files. Do not invent a component or token the tools do not return.
